exercises.title: Exercise 2: Validate User Payload with Pydantic
exercises.instructions: Create a UserSchema with email (must contain '@') and age (must be >= 18). Implement POST /users returning 201 Created.
exercises.starter_code:
from fastapi import FastAPI, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

app = FastAPI()

# Define UserSchema and POST /users
exercises.solution_hint: class UserSchema(BaseModel): email: str; age: int = Field(ge=18)

exercises.title: Exercise 3: Async Session Dependency
exercises.instructions: Implement a get_db dependency yielding an AsyncSession with proper exception handling and session close in a finally block.
exercises.starter_code:
from typing import AsyncGenerator

async def get_db() -> AsyncGenerator:

exercises.solution_hint: async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session: try: yield session finally: await session.close()

SECRET_KEY = 'secret'
ALGORITHM = 'HS256'
